description.short: Connects agents to Upwork and provides guided workflows for hiring and finding
description.full:
The Upwork Agent Plugin equips AI agents with skills for the full hiring lifecycle: search and vet freelancer talent, draft clear and effective job posts, write tailored proposals, and manage hiring workflows. Powered by the official Upwork MCP server for secure, real-time access to your Upwork account.

In order to use this app, you need to have an active Upwork account. Please contact our support team (https://support.upwork.com) for more details.

Get started: sign up or log in at https://www.upwork.com, then install this plugin and connect it to your Upwork account when prompted. A getting-started guide is available at https://www.upwork.com/ai/mcp.

Help and documentation: https://support.upwork.com

agentConnectors.description: Remote MCP server providing tools for upwork-agent-plugin
